title: Tournament & Eureka! compact
description: Makes Tournament & Eureka! balloon crafts compactibale in one modpack
body:
This datapack allows to use both Tournament & Eureka! addons for VS in one modpack.

It deletes craft via wool for Eureka!'s balloon allows craft Tournament's balloon instead. 
Also it makes Tournament unpowered balloon & Eureka! balloons interchangeble (like vertical and horizontal gears in Create mod)
